zones.n: Biscayne NP: bonefish seasonal closed area, no fishing 1 Mar to 31 May
zones.s: All fishing, spearfishing included, and all possession of fish is prohibited inside a small box of state waters in Biscayne National Park every year from 1 March through 31 May, until 28 February 2031. Transit is allowed with spear shafts out of the gun and all gear secured.

Seasonal: all fishing and possession of fish prohibited 1 March through 31 May, through 28 Feb 2031; outside the season it is open. Drawn as 'warn' because it is seasonal; render as closed in March to May if the app supports dates. The rule applies to state waters inside the box; part may lie beyond the 3 nm line, and the whole box is drawn (conservative). Datum not stated.

zones.n: Old Tampa Bay north of the Gandy Bridge: spears not on the allowed gear list
zones.s: In Old Tampa Bay north of the Gandy Bridge, and every creek and bayou that empties into it, fish may be taken only with hook and line, landing or dip net, cast net, or a lawful crab or shrimp trap, so spearfishing and gigging are prohibited there. The rule lists the only gear that may be used here (hook and line, landing or dip net, cast net, permitted crab and shrimp traps). A spear is not on the list.
zones.src: Geometry: NOAA ENC named sea area 'Old Tampa Bay', coastal band, cell US3GC06M.000 (CC0).
zones.flag: The rule covers Old Tampa Bay north of the Gandy Bridge AND every creek and bayou emptying into it. The drawn polygon is NOAA's charted 'Old Tampa Bay' area, whose south edge sits near the Gandy Bridge; the creeks and bayous are not drawn. Treat all of them as closed.

zones.n: Turkey Creek and Crane Creek (Brevard): spears not on the allowed gear list
zones.s: In Turkey Creek and Crane Creek (Palm Bay and Melbourne) and their tributaries, fish may be taken only with hook and line, landing or dip net, cast net, or a lawful crab trap, so spearfishing and gigging are prohibited.
zones.src: Geometry: NOAA ENC named sea areas 'Turkey Creek' (US5FL6SG.000) and 'Crane Creek' (US5FL6TG.000), harbour band (CC0).
zones.flag: The rule's line is across each creek mouth at the Indian River Lagoon; the charted creek polygons end where the chart's detail ends and do not cover the full upstream reach. Treat the whole creeks as closed.

zones.n: Steinhatchee River: fresh water by statute, no spearing and no speargun aboard

zones.n: Seminole: spring, gas or air weapon shooting banned citywide, spearfishing excepted only where designated

The whole incorporated area is drawn, including Lake Seminole (fresh water, where spearguns are barred by state rule anyway) and enclaves inside the outline. The offshore edge on Long Bayou and Boca Ciega Bay is soft.

zones.n: Riviera Beach: no spearfishing by Phil Foster Park and the Blue Heron Bridge

The south beach line and the shore line were read from imagery, not from a survey. zones.n: Palm Beach County parks: spear fishing banned on park property, park water included

zones.s: Fishing in Miami-Dade County park waters, fresh or salt, by spear, gig or any other device is prohibited except at places prescribed for it. Markers: Haulover Park and Crandon Park.
zones.src: Markers placed on USGS imagery at Haulover Park and Crandon Park. Not boundaries.
zones.flag: GEOMETRY NOT MAPPED. The rule reaches every county park with water (Haulover, Crandon, Matheson Hammock, Black Point, Homestead Bayfront and others), and 'park waters' has no stated seaward limit. Treat the water off any county park as closed to spearing.

zones.n: St. Marks: skin diving and scuba banned from Magnolia Street to 2nd Street
zones.s: Skin diving and scuba diving are unlawful from the west side of Magnolia Street to the south side of 2nd Street; diving gear on the water or the river banks there is prima facie evidence of a violation.
zones.src: Marker at the centroid of the TIGER incorporated place 'St. Marks city'. Not a boundary.
zones.flag: GEOMETRY NOT MAPPED. The section does not name the river, and the city sits where the St. Marks and Wakulla rivers meet. Treat both rivers inside the city as covered.
